newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fannie Mae upgraded to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fannie Mae upgraded to outperform.

text.p: -- Sanford Bernstein said it upgraded Fannie Mae to outperform from market perform.
-- Fannie Mae gained 1-3/4 to 39-3/8 in afternoon trading.
-- Sanford Bernstein also said it upgraded Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp to outperform from market perform.
-- Freddie Mac gained 1-3/4 to 113-3/4 in late trading.
-- sees long-term growth prospects for both stocks.
-- said both companies are capable of generating 12 percent and 14 percent earnings per share growth through the year 2000 in a stable interest rate environment.
